title: Amount Kept Back in a Medicaid Representative Payee Account from an Approved-Case Advance
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, when a representative sends an advance for the coming month on an approved case, part of what the resident's funds account under Resident Trust Fund Accounts would apply may be kept back.

**Rule.** The amount kept back from the funds the account applies to an advance: where the resident's funds account is a Medicaid representative payee account that keeps the personal needs allowance in the account and the case's tier deducts a community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance, the personal needs allowance plus the allowances on the case that the tier deducts, which the payee pays out of the benefit; where it is such an account on any other tier, the personal needs allowance, which stays in the account (a protected VA pension amount is not paid into a payee account, so nothing more is kept for it); otherwise nothing. An allowance the case does not record counts as zero.

**Questions answered by the rule** (personal needs allowance 45.00 dollars a month).

*A Medicaid Representative Payee account that keeps the personal needs allowance, on a case on the Community Spouse Allowance tier with a community spouse allowance of 528.70 dollars?* 45.00 plus 528.70 — 573.70 dollars is kept back.

*The same account on the Dependent Family Allowance tier with a family allowance of 302.15 dollars?* 347.15 dollars.

*The same account on the Home Maintenance Allowance tier with a home maintenance allowance on the case?* The personal needs allowance plus that allowance.

*The same account on the Standard Patient Pay, VA Reduced Pension or Hospice Room and Board tier?* 45.00 dollars; nothing more is kept for a protected VA pension.

*A Medicaid Representative Payee account that does not keep the personal needs allowance, or any other kind of account?* Nothing is kept back.
